findings.label: Tier card grid layout mismatch
findings.issue: Step 1 session type cards use a single-column grid on all breakpoints (grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;). The plan specifies 1 col mobile, 2 col tablet (640px+), 3 col desktop (768px+). Current markup shows inline styles that override the intended responsive behavior.
findings.action: Optional enhancement: use CSS media queries to set the grid to 2 or 3 columns on larger screens for better visual balance, though current 1-column layout is functional.

findings.label: Sidebar layout not strictly grid-based
findings.issue: The sidebar is implemented as a flex container (display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px;). Plan specifies a 360px width in grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px, but the sidebar cards themselves don't explicitly constrain to 360px—they rely on the parent grid.
findings.action: Optional: add width: 360px; to .sidebar-sticky or individual sidebar cards for defensive consistency, though current approach works correctly via grid layout.

findings.label: Subject selector label missing visual marker consistency
findings.issue: The subject input is marked '(optional)' in the label but the notes field below has a red asterisk to indicate required. The visual prominence is inconsistent.
findings.action: Minor UX clarity: consider adding '(optional)' label styling or a different visual marker to make optional fields stand out, though current implementation is functional.
